From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: 2026 performance review orchestration: timeline, forms & sensitive routing

Team —

I want to align on a tight, low-friction plan for the 2026 performance cycle. High-level goals: clarity for managers, safe handling of sensitive compensation conversations, and a calibration process that finishes before comp planning starts. Draft timeline and asks below; attached are initial forms and a sensitive-routing matrix.

Proposed timeline (target dates):
- 2026-05-01: Manager kickoff + updated evaluation form (attached: perf-review-forms-2026.docx)
- 2026-05-10 to 2026-05-24: Manager reviews and first-pass ratings
- 2026-05-26: Calibration meetings (team leads + execs)
- 2026-06-01: Finalized ratings -> handoff to People Ops for comp planning
- 2026-06-07 to 06-14: Manager one-on-ones + sensitive routing as needed

Operational asks:
1) Laura — can your comms team review the manager kickoff email + FAQ and prepare two cadence drafts (short & expanded) by 2026-04-22?
2) Aditya — sales has a shifted comp window; we need to confirm any exceptions and whether reps require an extended one-on-one window. Can you flag exceptions by 2026-04-23?
3) Evelyn — please validate the calibration participants list and confirm availability for 05-26 (I propose 3 blocks: 9–11a, 12–2p, 3–5p PT).
4) Claire / People Ops — guidance on sensitive cases: who should be the single point for routing escalations (we want to limit exposure to a small HR ops panel). See attached sensitive-routing-matrix.csv for proposed rules.

Notes: this cycle we want stricter sign-off on manager-written feedback for ICs subject to performance improvement plans. Keep the number of people with access to drafts as small as practical.

Thanks — please reply with quick alignment or edits. If no objections, I’ll lock the timeline tomorrow EOD.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

I recommend we move the manager kickoff to 2026-04-29 (two business days earlier) so people have the weekend to prepare, and split the manager review window into role-based buckets (ICs, EMs, Sales) so we can stagger calibration inputs.

Comms plan deliverables: short kickoff email, manager guide (1 pager), and an FAQ doc for employees with the escalation path spelled out. I can have the short + expanded drafts by 2026-04-21 if that's sufficient.

Also: we should lock down a sanitized example of a completed form to include in the manager guide — I can draft one from last year’s forms and anonymize it.

-Laura

Agree with Laura on staggering. A couple of constraints from Sales: comp planning for our quota-bearing reps kicks off 2026-06-10; if calibration drifts later than 06-01, we'll push comp deadlines.

Exceptions: a small set of reps on international deals will need 1:1s after managers get back from travel (final window 06-08 to 06-14). I'll send a short list (names + reason) by COB 2026-04-23.

Two asks for Ops: can calibration slides include a per-team variance report (last 18mo) so execs can see distributional drift? If Evelyn or someone can pull that into calibration-slides.pptx, that'd be helpful.

Subject: Re: 2026 performance review orchestration: timeline, forms & sensitive routing

Hi all — thanks for the overview and the routing matrix. Quick operational guidance from People Ops: 

1) Sensitive routing: designate a 3-person HR panel (People Ops lead + two senior HR partners). Escalations flagged as "sensitive" should only be shared via secure HR ticketing (HR-4521) and not emailed broadly. Your matrix is a good start; we recommend adding a column for "access-level" (view/edit).

2) Forms & versioning: use a single canonical form in Drive and lock editing to owners (People Ops + Laura). We can accept the .docx you provided and version via Drive; I'll upload a sanitized example by 2026-04-20.

3) Calibration: People Ops can host a 90-minute calibration prep session for managers with material on rating drift and bias. Please nominate who needs to attend — we can run two prep blocks the week before calibration.

I've attached a brief People Ops checklist in my reply (forwarded as an attachment stub below). If you want, I can run the sensitive-routing panel meeting the week of 04-27 to finalize rules.

—Claire
Claire Jenkins
Senior People Operations Consultant
Acme HR Partners
